# Format properties: Tables and matrices

> **Applies to:** Creators · Developers

Every card and property the Format pane offers for the visuals on this page (Table, Matrix), generated from the visual definitions in the code. For how to use the Format pane, see [Format a visual](../../create-reports/format-a-visual.md); for what these visuals do, see [the visual article](../../visuals/tables-and-matrices.md).

The cards on the **General** tab that every visual shares (title, effects, header icons, tooltips, alt text) are listed once in [General tab](general-tab.md).

| Visual | PBIR type | Visual-tab cards | Properties |
|---|---|---|---|
| Table | `tableEx` | 5 | 52 |
| Matrix | `pivotTable` | 10 | 97 |

## Table

PBIR visual type `tableEx` (also read as `table`).

### Visual tab

The Visual tab also starts with a **Layout** card (column width: fit to content, grow to fit, fixed width) and ends with **Cell elements** (conditional formatting per series). These cards are built by the table code, not from the definitions below.

#### Grid

PBIR object `grid`.

| Property | PBIR name | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| Horizontal gridlines | `gridHorizontal` | Toggle | On |
| Horizontal gridline color <br>_fx_ | `gridHorizontalColor` | Color | #E1DFDD |
| Horizontal gridline width | `gridHorizontalWeight` | Whole number (1 to 10) | 1 |
| Vertical gridlines | `gridVertical` | Toggle | Off |
| Vertical gridline color <br>_fx_ | `gridVerticalColor` | Color | #E1DFDD |
| Vertical gridline width | `gridVerticalWeight` | Whole number (1 to 10) | 1 |
| Border color <br>_fx_ | `outlineColor` | Color |  |

| Image height | `imageHeight` | Whole number (10 to 500) | 75 |
| Image width | `imageWidth` | Whole number (10 to 500) |  |
| Global font size | `textSize` | Font size |  |

## Matrix

PBIR visual type `pivotTable` (also read as `matrix`).

### Visual tab

The Visual tab also starts with a **Layout** card (column width: fit to content, grow to fit, fixed width) and ends with **Cell elements** (conditional formatting per series), and the matrix adds a per-level **Subtotals** card. These cards are built by the table code, not from the definitions below.

#### Layout and style presets

PBIR object `general`.

| Property | PBIR name | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| Layout | `layout` | List: Compact, Outline, Tabular |  |
